chain: per figure: the figure alone on its sheet (the other figures painted with the background) -> reconstruct-grid.mjs at the sheet's pitch (its standing figure's height over the 128 rows of the hero's x3 idle: a1 2.1875, a2 1.875, b2 2.2266, d1 2.4453, d2 2.4063, e1 2.2813, e2 2.2578, f2 2.1328; c1 / c2 1.797, between the pitch of their stand, 1.672, and the pitch that gives the RC1 frames' head, about 1.95: heads 7 % larger, bodies 7 % shorter) into a 384 x 288 frame, feet on row 270, --holes --no-shadow --closing-from=207 -> the grey halo peeled on the full colours -> nearest OKLab colour of the pinned palette -> islands under 12 texels removed -> the hips (the feet's midpoint; set by eye for the three knockout figures) on column 96, moved by the least that keeps the blade inside the cell (ready 8, strike cut 21, skillOff surge 52, skillOff thrust 34, dodge landing 15, knockout kneel 24 texels), the sole back on row 270

the blade at two texels (blade2): from the hilt end to the tip pinned per figure (BLADES, proposed by a RANSAC over the steel texels, checked on overlays), the old blade's loose neutral texels within 5 texels removed, a row of 248,233,216 along the segment and a row of 50,46,50 beside it (below a flat blade, behind a steep one), only where the figure was transparent or neutral; the tip on the foot row where the blade was the figure's lowest point

the rig: idle, ready and victory frame 1 = rig-engine's breath (inhale, lifts of 2 rows) of frame 0; recover frame 1 = the exhale (head lower); block frame 1 = the upper body sheared 3 texels back (the guard taking a blow); the recipe: rigs/hero-x3-combat.rig.mjs
